items.title: Cotton Dust Sheets and tarpaulin suppliers throughout the UK
items.body: If you are looking for high-quality and durable tarpaulin covers, dust sheets, sacks and bags, paint brushes and more; look no further than Tristar UK Ltd. All our products are directly sourced from Europe, India and the Far East; and we ensure all they are all of superior quality.

items.title: Experienced
items.body: Tristar are leading tool suppliers in Stevenage with almost 30 years of industry knowledge and experience we can help you find the perfect equipment and tools for your project. We stock a fully comprehensive range of tarpaulin, dust sheets and decorating accessories in a range of thickness and sizes. We have a wide variety and can help you find the most suitable products for your projects. Whether it be keeping your goods dry, protection against harsh weathers, or covering furniture while decorating we have it all. We also stock a wide range of sacks and bags including heavy duty rubble sacks and bin liners, wheelie bins liners; and paint brushes and rollers and painting supplies and equipment.

items.q: How do I place an order with Tristar?
items.a: You can directly purchase from the website or you can request for Quote (RFQ) for bulk orders. For more information contact the sales team at 01438 880 178 or by emailing sales@tristarltd.co.uk.

items.q: What are the standard payment terms?
items.a: Payment is due 30 days following the month of the invoice.

items.q: Do your prices include VAT?
items.a: No, all prices listed in the catalogue exclude VAT.

items.q: Are your prices fixed for the year?
items.a: Prices are subject to change without prior notice.

items.q: How can I contact the accounts or admin departments?
items.a: You can reach the Accounts department at 01438 880 862 and the Admin team at 01438 221 009.

items.q: Do you offer free delivery?
items.a: Yes, carriage is free of charge for all orders exceeding £495.

items.q: What is your standard delivery timeframe?
items.a: Standard delivery typically takes 2–3 working days.

items.q: Is next-day delivery available?
items.a: Yes, next-day delivery is available for UK mainland orders for an additional charge of £10.

items.q: What types of cotton dust sheets do you offer?
items.a: The range includes Contractor, Professional, Heavy Duty, Stairway, and Calico cotton twill sheets.

items.q: Do you provide waterproof floor protection?
items.a: Yes, we offer 100% waterproof polythene dust sheets, laminated cotton dust sheets, and self-adhesive carpet protector rolls.

items.q: What is the difference between Contractor and Professional dust sheets?
items.a: Contractor sheets (CDS1E) weigh approximately 1.4kg, while Professional heavyweight sheets (CDS1) weigh 1.8kg.

items.q: Are your dust sheets reusable?
items.a: Most cotton, canvas, and laminated dust sheets are designed to be strong, durable, and reusable.

items.q: Do you have specialized protection for stairs?
items.a: Yes, we offer a dedicated 24ft x 3ft Cotton Twill Stairway Dust Sheet (CDS3).

items.q: What paint brushes are available for professional use?
items.a: We stock Contractor and Acer ranges, featuring a quality mix of natural and synthetic bristles suitable for all paints and varnishes.

items.q: Can I customize my own roller tray set?
items.a: Yes, you can build a custom set by choosing 4", 7", or 9" trays and adding any number or type of refills (Foam, Microfibre, etc.).

items.q: Which roller refill is best for a smooth finish on cabinets?
items.a: Foam refills are ideal for applying thin, even coats of gloss or enamel on very smooth surfaces like cabinets and doors.

items.q: What options do you have for heavy-duty outdoor protection?
items.a: We offer 175g Extra Strong Green Tarpaulins that are tear-resistant and UV protected for outdoor and industrial use.

items.q: Do you sell bags suitable for heavy building waste?
items.a: Yes, we provide various rubble sacks and 'Tonne Bags' (up to 1000kg) with a 5:1 safety factor.

items.q: What is a 'Leno' tarpaulin used for?
items.a: Leno (clear) tarpaulins are ideal for projects requiring light penetration while keeping the area dry.

items.q: Do you supply bin liners for industrial use?
items.a: Yes, our range includes super heavy-duty dustbin liners, refuse sacks, and large wheelie bin liners.
